Open-source download manager for Windows and macOS.

No telemetry: none of the addresses you download are sent to any server.

add.name: File name
add.title: Add download
col.name: Name
det.segments: {0} segments · orange: downloaded, line: segment boundary
det.segments_hint: Each connection downloads one part of the file
grab.title: Site Grabber
limit.title: Custom speed limit
msg.av_warning: The antivirus reported a warning for {0}.
msg.quota_paused: Download quota reached; downloads will resume at {0}.
msg.quota_resumed: Download quota available again; downloads resumed.
msg.update_bad_hash: The update file's SHA-256 does not match; nothing was installed.
power.hibernate_in: The computer will hibernate. Press Cancel to stop it.
power.shutdown_in: The computer will shut down. Press Cancel to stop it.
power.sleep_in: The computer will go to sleep. Press Cancel to stop it.
prefs.av_enabled: Scan downloaded files with an antivirus
prefs.av_hint: {file} is replaced with the file path; the command runs without a shell.
prefs.browser_show_dialog: Show the add window for captured downloads
prefs.category_hint: If the folder is empty files go straight into the download folder; a relative name is created inside it.
prefs.clipboard_hint: Opens the add window when you copy an address ending in one of the captured extensions.
prefs.close_to_tray: Close button minimizes to the notification area
prefs.connections_hint: A download starts with one connection and grows up to this number if the server allows it.
prefs.ffmpeg_hint: Used to merge HLS/DASH streams into a single MP4 (no re-encoding). Enter "none" to disable; streams then stay as .ts or separate audio/video files.
prefs.notify_complete: Show a notification when a download finishes
prefs.privacy: Karadelik DM sends no usage data. Download addresses, cookies and file names stay on this computer.
prefs.proxy_hint: Empty: direct connection. http://, socks4:// and socks5:// are supported; credentials can go in the address.
prefs.quota_hint: When the limit is reached downloads pause and resume automatically as the window moves on.
prefs.start_minimized: Start minimized to the notification area
prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.use_categories: Sort files into folders by category
queues.empty: No files waiting in this queue.
queues.name: Name
queues.title: Queues and scheduler
refresh.label: New address
refresh.title: Refresh download address
remove.files:
These files will also be deleted from disk:

{0}
remove.title: Delete files
ui.empty_text: Press Add, drag an address onto the window or paste one with Ctrl+V.
ui.quota_paused: Download quota reached; downloads are paused.
ui.quota_until: Download quota reached; downloads will resume at {0}.
update.confirm:
Update from {1} to {0}?

Running downloads are paused and resume where they left off after the app reopens.
update.title: Update Karadelik DM
zip.no_range: The server does not support partial downloads; the contents can only be shown after the whole archive is downloaded.
zip.title: ZIP contents
prefs.ftp_tls_hint: ftps:// addresses are always encrypted. This setting applies to ftp:// addresses; the download stops if the certificate cannot be verified.
add.open_torrent_hint: Choose a .torrent file from this computer
add.torrent_resolving: Fetching torrent details from peers (DHT / trackers)…
add.torrent_no_meta: you can still add it; details are requested again when it starts and all files are downloaded
prefs.t_dht: Find peers with DHT (needed for trackerless magnet links)
prefs.t_lsd: Find peers on the local network
prefs.t_upnp: Open the port on the router automatically (UPnP)
prefs.t_upnp_hint: Downloads work with this off; turning it on brings more incoming peers but opens a router port by itself.
prefs.t_ratio_hint: Seeding stops and the files are released once uploaded / size reaches this ratio.
prefs.t_registered: Registered. The browser may ask for permission on the first magnet link.
prefs.t_note: Port, DHT, UPnP and local network settings take effect after a restart. In BitTorrent your IP address is visible to the peers you connect to. The torrent session does not open until the first torrent starts.
prefs.ext_step1: Type in the browser's address bar:
prefs.ext_step2: Turn on "Developer mode" at the top right.
prefs.ext_step4: In the window that opens, paste into its address bar (Ctrl+V) and select the folder. The path has been copied:
prefs.ext_keep: Keep this folder; the browser runs the extension from it. Once the extension is in the store, this button will open the store page.
prefs.update_check: Check for updates automatically (at start and once a day)
msg.up_to_date: Karadelik Download Manager is up to date ({0}).
prefs.ext_store_note: The store page is open in the browser: click "Add to Chrome" (Edge first asks to "Allow extensions from other stores"). If you installed a copy by hand earlier, remove it on the extensions page; with both, downloads are caught twice.
prefs.t_seed_after: Keep seeding when a torrent finishes
prefs.t_seed_hint: When off, start seeding a finished torrent yourself with "Seed" on its row. While seeding, the files are kept open; stop seeding before running files such as installers.
prog.hide_hint: Closes the window; the download continues
prefs.show_progress: Show the progress window when a download starts
prefs.show_complete: Show the "Download complete" window when a download finishes
prefs.show_windows_hint: For single downloads you start from the add window or the browser. Queue and batch downloads stay silent.
